units.source_text: ——转眼间，这一消息从副司的嘴里传遍了整个寺庙。

en.t: In the blink of an eye, this news spread from the deputy priest's mouth throughout the entire temple.

units.source_text: 因为老师许下诺言让我上大学深造，这是受到格外器重的证据。

en.t: Because the teacher had promised to let me go on to university for further study, it was proof that I was being treated with exceptional favor.

units.source_text: 据说从前有些弟子为了争取上大学，

en.t: It was said that in the past, some disciples, in order to win the chance to attend university,

units.source_text: 甚至必须百夜到住持房间给他擦肩搓背，才能如愿以偿。

en.t: even had to go to the abbot's room for a hundred nights to rub his shoulders and back before their wish could be granted.

units.source_text: 诸如此类的事堆积如山。

en.t: Stories of that kind had piled up like a mountain.

units.source_text: 决定依靠家里提供费用上大谷大学的鹤川，拍了拍我的肩膀，为我高兴。

en.t: Tsurukawa, who had decided to attend Otani University with expenses provided by his family, patted me on the shoulder and rejoiced for me.

units.source_text: 而另一个得不到老师任何关照的师弟，竟因此而不同我交往了。

en.t: But another junior disciple, who received no attention from the teacher at all, actually stopped associating with me because of it.
